name: RenderViz
description: A developer tool for debugging render cache metadata (cacheability).
project_description:
Render Visualization makes the cache properties of Drupal's render array output accessible by visualising them.

 See https://wimleers.com/blog/renderviz-prototype .

 

 Render Visualization module is currently work in progress. Please contribute!

 Requirements 
 This module requires no modules outside of Drupal core.

 Configuration 
 The module has no menu or modifiable settings. There is no configuration.

 Alternatives 
 
 Since Drupal 9.5.0, it is possible to output render cache debug .
